statement: Regime state outputs shall never generate BUY/SELL orders or long/short recommendations
Regimes represent environmental volatility, trend, and macro conditions, not market entry triggers
Taxonomy terms such as bullish/bearish are prohibited in favor of persistent or reverting context
Regime values are descriptive descriptive indicators, never supervised ML target labels or price predictions
No model training (HMM, GMM, clustering, SVM) is executed during foundation phase
Regimes shall not trigger backtesting, strategy execution, or portfolio optimization
